LanguageData.GlitterstimAddiction.label: glitterstim addiction
LanguageData.GlitterstimAddiction.description:
A chemical addiction to glitterstim. Long-term presence of glitterstim has caused neurological adaptations at the cellular level, so the brain can no longer function properly without the drug.
Without regular doses of glitterstim, withdrawal symptoms will begin. However, extended abstinence will force the brain to adapt back to its normal state, resolving the addiction.
LanguageData.GlitterstimHigh.label: high on glitterstim
LanguageData.GlitterstimHigh.description: Glitterstim in the bloodstream. It enhances consciousness and increases psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.GlitterstimTolerance.label: glitterstim tolerance
LanguageData.GlitterstimTolerance.description: A built-up tolerance to glitterstim. The more severe this tolerance is, the more glitterstim it takes to get the same effect.
LanguageData.GlitterstimTolerance.stages.small.label: small
LanguageData.GlitterstimTolerance.stages.large.label: large
